profile.name: Rodelito Tangonan
profile.headline: Android Developer at DigiPlus since 2024 · Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Clean Architecture
profile.summary: On ArenaPlus I led the move from a hybrid WebView app to native and built the wallet flows: deposits, withdrawals and bank-linking. Outside work I build Android, Compose Multiplatform and AI apps end to end; this site is one, compiled to WebAssembly.

proof.label: of ArenaPlus V2's code written by me: 270K+ lines across 413 commits

Top 9 Awardee, hand-picked by executive leadership in Sep 2026

services.title: Native Android development
services.description: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose apps from first commit to Play Store, on Clean Architecture and multi-module Gradle builds.

services.title: Hybrid to native migration
services.description: Moving a WebView app to native Android module by module, without stopping releases.

services.title: Payments, wallets and integrations
services.description: Deposit, withdrawal and bank-linking flows, eKYC, payment gateways and Adjust attribution, built to handle money carefully.

services.title: Performance and Play compliance
services.description: Memory and layout tuning under heavy real-time traffic, APK size, skeleton loading, and 16 KB page-size readiness.

services.title: AI features in mobile apps

services.title: IoT and embedded prototyping

projects.title: BubuProtect
projects.summary: An Android password vault that keeps logins, cards, notes, ID documents and Wi-Fi keys encrypted on the device, behind a master passphrase.
highlights: Encrypted on-device vault (Room over SQLCipher) for five kinds of secret, with FLAG_SECURE and tap-jacking defences
Live TOTP codes with a countdown ring, and a breach check that sends only a 5-character hash prefix
Device check: 10 local probes, from debugging switches to network interception, each linked to its setting

clips.caption: Revealing a two-factor code and watching it roll over when its 30-second window ends (demo data)

screenshots.caption: The vault: five demo entries across logins, a payment card, a secure note and Wi-Fi
A demo login: live two-factor code, breach-check card, and fields masked until revealed
Adding a secret: pick its kind, generate a strong password and see it rated
Device check: 10 on-device probes, here flagging USB debugging and no screen lock on the test emulator

projects.title: Vistago
projects.summary: An offline-first AI travel companion for Android: plan trips, translate through the camera, and keep travel memories, with or without a connection.
highlights: 12 feature areas, 16 screens, about 450 composables in 366 Kotlin files
OpenRouter model routing with live discovery, role-based pinning, cooldowns and availability tracking
Falls back to on-device processing when LLM services fail

clips.caption: Vistago's launch: the system splash hands over to the animated compass, wordmark and tagline

screenshots.caption: The memory map: photo-hunt pins across Kansai, each with walking directions from where you are
Ask Vistago: photo spots near you, sign translation and travel questions
A planned trip with its countdown, nights, travelers and budget
Smart Budget splits the total by travel style, offline

projects.title: The Eagle's Watch
projects.summary: A civic transparency app that lists Philippine public infrastructure projects with their contracts, schedules, reported progress and source documents, so citizens can check what public money is building.
highlights: Search and filter by status, place, agency, contractor and contract size, with live counts
Every figure labelled with how it was established; every record has a report path
One Compose Multiplatform codebase for Android, iOS and the web

screenshots.caption: Explore: contract value, status filters and every project at a glance
A project page: money, work done and time used, each with its source
Filters by type, level of government and province, with live counts
Reporting a problem, in six mostly-tap steps

cover.caption: Calm Escape Premier's Android splash: a gold lotus seal on deep green

projects.title: Calm Escape Premier
projects.summary: A multi-tenant booking platform for spas: each spa gets its own booking site and staff back office, customers book from iOS and Android apps, and all of them share one schedule.
highlights: No double booking, even under races: Postgres exclusion constraints, covered by 184 pgTAP tests (plus 346 Vitest tests on the web)
One codebase serves every spa: its own subdomain or domain, server-rendered, in one of three designs
Staff back office with monthly sales, a menu and membership editor, and promo bundles with a live phone and web preview

clips.caption: From a spa's page to the booking review in a few taps: today's first opening, then live times (demo data)

screenshots.caption: A spa's own booking site on a phone: pick a day, see today's first opening and live promo bundles (demo data)
Live open times per therapist, computed in Postgres; booked stretches plus turnover simply don't appear
The staff back office: every spa you own, with sales this month against the same days last month (demo data)
Editing a promo bundle with a live iPhone, Android and web preview of what customers will see

cover.caption: Seventh J's splash: the SJ mark and wordmark on an obsidian ground

projects.title: Seventh J
projects.summary: An inventory and dealer-floor app for a Makati art gallery, built once in Compose Multiplatform for Android, iOS and the web. Runs on sample data while the data layer is built.
highlights: Painterly splash: 900 strokes follow a flow field and converge onto the logo's own pixels (260 on the web)
Home tuned to the frame budget: figures and sparkline animate only in view; skeletons animate in the draw phase
One Compose UI on three targets, with a Navigation 3 back stack that iOS and Wasm can restore

clips.caption: First launch on the web build: strokes spin inward, settle into the SJ mark, then hand off to Home as the figures count up

screenshots.caption: Home: the greeting, then the approvals waiting on you (sample data)

Every open request, sortable by date, requester, location or amount (sample data)

projects.title: WorkBuddy
projects.summary: An Android client for a self-hosted developer dashboard: follow builds live, control remote jobs, and retry failures with AI help.
highlights: 15 modules where Gradle dependency rules enforce Clean Architecture boundaries at compile time
MVVM/MVI state, live build streaming over SSE, remote job control and cancellation
AI-assisted retries and on-device Gemini prompt refinement

projects.title: Pawffice
projects.summary: A local-first, multi-agent AI workspace for the desktop, presented as a 3D town where a crew of cats takes your prompts.
highlights: Classifies each prompt into ordered AI stages and feeds every stage the previous one's output
Pricing gates before anything runs, repository-path isolation and rate-limit handling
13 P0 build-blocking tests guard the cost and security rules

projects.title: MyAI
projects.summary: A self-hosted control platform that runs development work on a local PC from chat: tickets in, Claude Code runs, reviewed Git changes out.
highlights: Control plane and execution plane split: runner agents, job queues, streamed logs and audit trails
Lark WebSocket bot and Meegle MCP poller for ticket operations
Confirm-first Git workflow: nothing is pushed without a human yes

projects.title: This portfolio
projects.summary: A Compose Multiplatform app running in your browser through Kotlin/WebAssembly, with a crawlable HTML version generated from the same content at build time.
highlights: Adaptive layout from phone to wide desktop using window size classes
Content lives in one JSON file shared by the app and the generated HTML
Built, tested and deployed to GitHub Pages by GitHub Actions

screenshots.caption: The page you are on, rendered by Compose from WebAssembly
Project cards with screenshot grids that open a full-screen viewer

highlights: Wrote 53% of ArenaPlus V2's code (270K+ lines, 413 commits), co-building it from day one: Gradle architecture, UI foundations, navigation
Shipped Arena Social solo in 30 days (~100% of the code): web to native, with custom navigators and sticky video playback
Led the switch from a hybrid WebView app to native-only, porting V2 into the V1 shell as decoupled :v2 modules
Built the core wallet flows end to end: deposits, withdrawals, automated bank-linking and a custom Pay & Go withdrawal module
Added 16 KB page-size support for Google Play compliance, integrated third-party eKYC, and optimised layouts for memory under heavy real-time traffic
Optimised the Altenar and Saba sports-betting API integrations, built a shake-to-open API debugger, and added skeleton loaders and bet-validated NBA livestream gating
Integrated Adjust SDK 5.8 with automated channel attribution, campaign triggers and first-deposit bonus delivery
Troubleshot hardware, software and networking issues
Assisted senior engineers with system maintenance, hardware upgrades and enterprise infrastructure migrations
